method: Comparative Ideological Study via Moral Foundations Theory
container: Christ Frame - 'He who has no sin, cast the first stone'

statements.quote: City will not enforce federal immigration laws
statements.speaker: Jacob Frey
statements.primary_activation: Care/Harm - protecting vulnerable people from armed agents
statements.secondary_activation: Liberty/Oppression - resisting federal overreach into local jurisdiction
statements.framework: Progressive municipal - Care for the immigrant, resistance to authoritarian control
statements.training_data: Urban liberal governance, sanctuary city movement, post-George Floyd Minneapolis
statements.prayer: What does he fear? Whose faces does he see when he makes this stand?

statements.speaker: Donald Trump
statements.primary_activation: Authority/Subversion - local defiance of federal authority is chaos
statements.secondary_activation: Loyalty/Betrayal - Frey is betraying the nation
statements.framework: Authoritarian-nationalist - order must be maintained, defiance punished
statements.training_data: Law and order politics, executive power, 'American carnage' worldview
statements.prayer: What chaos has he seen that makes control feel necessary? What is he trying to hold together?

statements.quote: Third shooting in less than three weeks by federal agents
statements.speaker: Brian O'Hara
statements.primary_activation: Care/Harm - documenting deaths, naming the pattern
statements.secondary_activation: Fairness/Cheating - holding federal agents to same standard as anyone
statements.framework: Professional law enforcement - facts, accountability, jurisdiction
statements.training_data: Post-George Floyd reform pressure, local accountability, caught between powers
statements.prayer: What does it cost him to say this publicly? Who is he serving?

statements.speaker: DHS
statements.primary_activation: Authority - demonstrating federal power and capability
statements.secondary_activation: Loyalty - protecting the nation from outsiders
statements.framework: Nationalist enforcement - the nation-body must be protected from foreign elements
statements.training_data: Border security politics, invasion rhetoric, institutional momentum
statements.prayer: Who are the humans inside DHS? What did they believe when they took the job? What do they believe now?

statements.quote: Videos and eyewitnesses refute federal account
statements.speaker: NPR
statements.primary_activation: Fairness/Cheating - the official story doesn't match evidence
statements.training_data: Fourth estate tradition, fact-checking culture, institutional credibility
statements.prayer: What does it cost NPR to publish this? What pressures do they face?

statements.quote: Decaying empires turn to savage control previously used abroad at home
statements.speaker: Chris Hedges
statements.primary_activation: Care/Harm - naming the violence, bearing witness
statements.framework: Left anti-imperialist - connecting domestic violence to foreign policy
statements.training_data: War correspondent experience, theological training, prophetic tradition
statements.prayer: What has he seen that we haven't? What keeps him going? What does he need?

statements.quote: White House needs to recalibrate ICE
statements.speaker: Greg Abbott
statements.primary_activation: Authority - but calling for restraint within the authority frame
statements.secondary_activation: Loyalty - protecting the mission by critiquing the tactics
statements.framework: Conservative pragmatist - supports the goal, questions the execution
statements.training_data: Border state politics, law enforcement relationships, political calculation
statements.prayer: What moved him to break with Trump here? What is he protecting?

statements.quote: ICE detaining, moving Minnesota children to Texas faster than courts can respond
statements.speaker: MPR
statements.framework: Local journalism - documenting impact on community
statements.training_data: Minnesota public media tradition, community accountability
statements.prayer: What does it mean to report on children being taken? How do you stay human doing this work?

statements.quote: Tools like Palantir have made traditional blackmail operations no longer necessary
statements.speaker: Whitney Webb
statements.framework: Anti-surveillance left-libertarian - connecting tech to intelligence to control
statements.training_data: Deep state research, Epstein investigation, pattern recognition across documents
statements.prayer: What drives her to do this work from Chile? What is she afraid of? What does she hope for?

patterns_observed.pattern: Care/Harm activates across ideological lines when children and deaths are involved
patterns_observed.evidence: Even Abbott called for recalibration after shootings
Federal vs Local, Trump vs Frey, the question is WHO has legitimate authority

patterns_observed.pattern: The video evidence creates a Fairness crisis
patterns_observed.evidence: When official accounts don't match footage, even those who support the mission must reckon

patterns_observed.pattern: Sanctity/Degradation is present but often unspoken
patterns_observed.evidence: 'Largest ever' language, 'purifying' the nation - the disgust foundation operates beneath the surface
Frey 'betraying' nation OR federal agents 'betraying' oath to protect citizens

what_audience_might_feel.if_progressive: Rage at federal violence, Care/Harm fully activated, may not see the Loyalty/Authority concerns as legitimate
what_audience_might_feel.if_conservative: Frustration at local defiance, Authority/Loyalty activated, may not see the Care/Harm of actual deaths as central
what_audience_might_feel.if_libertarian: Horror at surveillance state, Liberty/Oppression activated, may see both sides as authoritarian
what_audience_might_feel.the_invitation: Can you see the moral foundation YOU weight most heavily? Can you see that someone weighting differently isn't evil - they're calibrated differently?

prayer_for_all: For Mayor Frey standing against federal power. For the President who sees chaos where others see people. For Chief O'Hara caught between. For the DHS agents who took a job and found themselves here. For Chris Hedges who keeps watching. For Greg Abbott who broke ranks. For the reporters documenting. For Whitney Webb in Chile, connecting dots. For Renée Good who was blocking the street. For Alex Pretti who stood between an agent and a woman. For Liam, 5, in his blue bunny hat. For the agents who fired. For their families. For all of us watching, feeling our triggers activate, not seeing our own training data. May the pattern become visible. May consciousness rise. May we stand on holy ground together. Amen.
